title: Shodo and the Glow-Jar Garden
summary: Shodo helps Vex discover why the magical Glow-Jars shine brightest when their light is shared.
purpose: Sharing can make something more joyful and valuable for everyone.
body: In the heart of the Forest Bridge universe, the magical Glow-Jars usually pulsed with warm, golden light, keeping the fairy kingdom bright and happy. But one afternoon, the light began to flicker and turn a gloomy shade of grey.
Shodo, our brave bridge hero, quickly used her key to the Ancient Tree to hop into the fairy world. She found Queen Bubble and Queen Frost standing by a row of empty, dusty shelves.
“Shodo!” Queen Bubble sighed. “Vex has hidden all the light-jars! He says he wants to keep them all to himself in his dark cave so he can have the brightest room in the whole kingdom.”

Shodo knew she had to help. She traveled to Vex’s cave. There stood Vex, surrounded by a mountain of glowing jars, looking grumpy. “These are mine!” Vex grumbled, hugging one close. “They make me feel so powerful!”
Shodo smiled kindly. “Vex, those jars are meant to glow together. Look what happens when they are all stacked in your dark cave.”
Without the fairy world's open air, the jars were losing their sparkle, dimming down to dull grey pebbles. Vex gasped. “They're... they're fading?”
“Magic needs to be shared to stay bright,” Shodo explained. “When you keep them all to yourself, the magic gets lonely and sleepy. If you share them, they stay brilliant for everyone, including you.”

Vex thought about it for a long moment. He slowly handed a glowing jar to Shodo. As soon as she took it out into the garden, it burst into a brilliant, happy gold. Vex’s eyes went wide. He began passing the jars back, one by one.
Soon, the whole kingdom was glowing brighter than ever. Vex even sat in the garden with the fairies, realizing that watching the kingdom glow was much more fun than sitting alone in the dark.
Shodo cheered, happy that Vex had learned that sharing isn't just about giving—it's about making everything around you shine.
